name: QControl
description: QControl coordinates Jellyfin playback presence with temporary qBittorrent Alternative Limits or explicit torrent stops.
overview: Reduce qBittorrent activity while Jellyfin playback is present.

versions.changelog: Adds unauthenticated qBittorrent access, explicit credential-set actions, creatable multi-tag exclusions with global-catalog suggestions, fresh tag defaults, and more tolerant queued-start recovery.

First alpha candidate with playback-driven Alternative Limits and journaled explicit-torrent control, administrator configuration, and conservative interruption recovery for Jellyfin 10.11.11 and qBittorrent 5.2.3.
